बड़ी खबर! मिर्ज़ापुर द मूवी अब सीधे आपके घर के स्क्रीन पर आ गई है। 💥

थिएटर में ब्लॉकबस्टर साबित होने के बाद अब ये फिल्म Prime Video पर आ गई है।
प्लेटफॉर्म ने भारत समेत दुनिया भर के २४० से ज्यादा देशों में ग्लोबल स्ट्रीमिंग प्रीमियर का ऐलान किया है।
इस डिजिटल रिलीज़ में दर्शकों के लिए एक बड़ा ट्रीट है, क्योंकि इसमें एक्सटेंडेड कट और कभी न देखे गए सीन्स मिलेंगे।
कहानी सीजन १ की टाइमलाइन पर सेट है, जिसमें पुरवांचल से लेकर रेगिस्तान तक सत्ता की जंग दिखाई गई है।
डायरेक्टर गुरमीत सिंह हैं और इसे पुनीत कृष्ण ने लिखा है, जिसमें पंकज त्रिपाठी और अली फज़ल लीड रोल में हैं।
क्या आपने ये फिल्म थिएटर में देखी थी या अब ओटीटी पर देखेंगे? 🍿👇

ctx.title: Mirzapur: The Movie Now Streaming: Pankaj Tripathi & Ali Fazal’s Crime Saga Gets An Extended Cut
ctx.summary:
Mirzapur: The Movie is now streaming with an extended cut featuring never-before-seen scenes, bringing more drama and action from the crime thriller franchise. 
 The post  Mirzapur: The Movie Now Streaming: Pankaj Tripathi & Ali Fazal’s Crime Saga Gets An Extended Cut  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Mirzapur: The Movie brings the most loved crime thriller series to life on the big screen. The series received immense love, and the makers made a film version, which also received a positive response, turning it into a blockbuster.
After the successful theatrical run, the audience has been waiting for its release on digital platforms. For those who have been waiting to watch the film on their home screens and those who wanted to rewatch, the wait is over. Mirzapur: The Movie has finally made its way to OTT.
After making the leap from streaming to the big screen in a triumphant theatrical run, Mirzapur: The Movie has returned to where the iconic world of Purvanchal first found its home. The film is now streaming exclusively on Prime Video. The platform announced the global streaming premiere of the film in India and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.
Well, the release comes with an added treat. The streaming release also features an extended cut with never-before-seen scenes, offering viewers additional footage beyond the theatrical version.
Mirzapur is a gritty, high-stakes crime drama set in the lawless Purvanchal region of Uttar Pradesh, centering on a brutal struggle for power, revenge, and control of the illegal underworld. The story primarily revolves around the clash between the ruling Tripathi mafia family and the upstart Pandit brothers.
The film brings back the power struggles and rivalries that have been central to the franchise. Set during the timeline of Season 1, it explores an untold story featuring several familiar characters. The story moves beyond Purvanchal to the desert, where the fight for Mirzapur’s throne takes an unexpected turn. The extended version adds scenes that were not part of the theatrical cut.
Directed by Gurmmeet Singh and written by Puneet Krishna, the film features Ali Fazal, Pankaj Tripathi , and Divyenndu in leading roles. The supporting cast includes Jitendra Kumar, Ravi Kishan, Abhishek Banerjee, Rasika Dugal, Mohit Malik, Sheeba Chaddha, Rajesh Tailang, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Harshita Gaur, Shweta Tripathi Sharma, Sonal Chauhan, Anangsha Biswas, Shaji Chaudhary, Satendra Soni, Kulbhushan Kharbanda, and Sushant Singh.
Presented by Amazon MGM Studios and Excel Entertainment, the film is produced by Ritesh Sidhwani and Farhan Akhtar under the Excel Entertainment banner.
